summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Pacific Airport Group (NYSE: PAC) reporting the resolutions adopted at its Annual General Ordinary Shareholders Meeting held on April 22, 2026. The filing covers standard approvals of financial statements, board actions, committee reports, and tax compliance for fiscal year 2025. There are no special-situation events such as mergers, tenders, restructurings, or management changes triggering this filing. It is a periodic disclosure of ordinary corporate governance.
